premise: Butterfly lands on Fox's head — AH-CHOO! — Fox's sneeze blows her onto Mushroom's cap, her wings tickle Mushroom — ACHOO! — the glitter lands on Hedgehog's nose — tishoo! — his sneeze blows it back to Fox, and this time the sneeze comes out as a giggle.
inspiration: This Is the House That Jack Built and For Want of a Nail (cumulative folk chains), turned into a sneeze that travels round and ends as a laugh.
lesson: A giggle spreads just as easily as a sneeze.

en-US.title: The Sneeze That Went Round
en-US.text: [softly] {mushroom:enter} Mushroom was standing quietly in the meadow, and {hedgehog:enter} Hedgehog came scurrying up {hedgehog:go to mushroom} to doze beside her. {hedgehog:face sleeping} All was calm. Then along trotted {fox:enter} Fox, and {butterfly:enter} Butterfly fluttered down {butterfly:go on fox} right on top of his head. Tickle, tickle. {fox:face surprised} {fox:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:big-sneeze} AH-CHOO! {fox:wobble x2} [surprised] Whoosh! The sneeze blew Butterfly {butterfly:go on mushroom} onto Mushroom's cap. {butterfly:live rest} She folded her wings, then fluttered them. Tickle, tickle. {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Ah… ah… [pause] {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ACHOO! Up puffed some glitter, and down it floated… onto Hedgehog's nose. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:live curl} Hedgehog curled up tight… then slowly peeked out. His nose twitched. Ah… {hedgehog:live sneeze} ah… {sfx:tiny-sneeze} tishoo! His tiny sneeze blew the glitter all the way over to Fox. Fox's nose twitched. Ah… ah… [pause] Everyone waited. {all:face surprised} But instead of sneezing… Fox {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} giggled. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} And that giggle went all the way round the meadow.

es-ES.title: El estornudo que dio la vuelta
es-ES.text: [softly] {mushroom:enter} Seta estaba tan tranquila en el prado, y {hedgehog:enter} Erizo llegó correteando {hedgehog:go to mushroom} a echarse una cabezadita a su lado. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Todo estaba en calma. Entonces llegó trotando {fox:enter} Zorro, y {butterfly:enter} Mariposa bajó revoloteando {butterfly:go on fox} y se le posó en la cabeza. Cosquillas, cosquillas. {fox:face surprised} {fox:live sneeze} Aaa… aaa… {sfx:big-sneeze} ¡AAACHÍS! {fox:wobble x2} [surprised] ¡Fiuuu! El estornudo mandó a Mariposa {butterfly:go on mushroom} al sombrero de Seta. {butterfly:live rest} Plegó las alas, y luego las agitó. Cosquillas, cosquillas. {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Aaa… aaa… [pause] {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ¡ACHÍS! Salió un polvillo de purpurina, que bajó flotando… hasta la nariz de Erizo. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:live curl} Erizo se hizo una bola… y luego asomó despacito. Le temblaba la nariz. Aaa… {hedgehog:live sneeze} aaa… {sfx:tiny-sneeze} ¡chis! Su estornudito mandó la purpurina volando… hasta Zorro. A Zorro le temblaba la nariz. Aaa… aaa… [pause] Todos esperaron. {all:face surprised} Pero en vez de estornudar… Zorro {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} se echó a reír. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} Y la risa dio la vuelta a todo el prado.

ja-JP.title: くしゃみが ぐるっと ひとまわり
ja-JP.text: [softly]{mushroom:enter}キノコが、のはらにしずかに立っていました。{hedgehog:enter}ハリネズミくんがきて、{hedgehog:go to mushroom}となりでうとうと。{hedgehog:face sleeping}しーん。そこへ{fox:enter}キツネくんがとことこ。{butterfly:enter}チョウチョさんがひらひらおりて、{butterfly:go on fox}あたまにちょこん。こちょこちょ。{fox:face surprised}{fox:live sneeze}は…は…{sfx:big-sneeze}はーっくしょん！{fox:wobble x2}[surprised]ぴゅーっ！チョウチョさんは、{butterfly:go on mushroom}キノコのかさの上へ。{butterfly:live rest}はねをとじて、ぱたぱた。こちょこちょ。{mushroom:live sneeze hold}は…は…[pause]{mushroom:live sneeze resume}{sfx:achoo}へっくしょん！キラキラのこなが、ぽわん。ふわふわおりて…ハリネズミくんのはなに。{hedgehog:face surprised}{hedgehog:live curl}ハリネズミくんはくるんとまるくなって…そうっと、ひょっこり。はなが、ひくひく。は…{hedgehog:live sneeze}は…{sfx:tiny-sneeze}くちゅん！ちっちゃなくしゃみで、キラキラはキツネくんのところまで。キツネくんのはなが、ひくひく。は…は…[pause]みんな、じっとまちました。{all:face surprised}ところがキツネくんは、くしゃみのかわりに…{fox:face happy}{fox:wobble}くすくす、わらいだしました。[laughs]{all:face happy}{all:wobble}そのわらいが、のはらをぐるっとひとまわり。

de-DE.title: Ein Hatschi macht die Runde
de-DE.text: [softly] {mushroom:enter} Der Pilz stand ganz still auf der Wiese, und {hedgehog:enter} der Igel kam herangetrippelt {hedgehog:go to mushroom} und döste neben ihm ein. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Alles war ruhig. Da kam {fox:enter} der Fuchs angetrabt, und {butterfly:enter} der Schmetterling flatterte herab {butterfly:go on fox} und landete ihm mitten auf dem Kopf. Kitzel, kitzel. {fox:face surprised} {fox:live sneeze} Haa… haaa… {sfx:big-sneeze} HAAATSCHI! {fox:wobble x2} [surprised] Wusch! Der Nieser pustete den Schmetterling {butterfly:go on mushroom} auf den Hut des Pilzes. {butterfly:live rest} Der Schmetterling klappte die Flügel zu… und wieder auf. Kitzel, kitzel. {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Haa… haaa… [pause] {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} HATSCHI! Glitzerstaub puffte hoch und schwebte herab… dem Igel genau auf die Nase. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:live curl} Der Igel rollte sich ganz fest zusammen… und lugte dann langsam wieder hervor. Seine Nase zuckte. Haa… {hedgehog:live sneeze} haa… {sfx:tiny-sneeze} hitschi! Sein winziger Nieser pustete den Glitzer bis hinüber zum Fuchs. Da zuckte dem Fuchs die Nase. Haa… haaa… [pause] Alle warteten. {all:face surprised} Doch statt zu niesen… {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} kicherte der Fuchs. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} Und das Kichern ging einmal rund um die ganze Wiese.

fr-FR.title: L’atchoum qui fait le tour
fr-FR.text: [softly] {mushroom:enter} Champignon était tout tranquille dans le pré, et {hedgehog:enter} Hérisson est arrivé en trottinant {hedgehog:go to mushroom} pour faire un somme à côté de lui. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Tout était calme. Puis {fox:enter} Renard est passé au trot, et {butterfly:enter} Papillon est descendu en voletant {butterfly:go on fox} se poser pile sur sa tête. Guili, guili. {fox:face surprised} {fox:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:big-sneeze} AAATCHOUM ! {fox:wobble x2} [surprised] Fouuu ! L’éternuement a envoyé Papillon {butterfly:go on mushroom} sur le chapeau de Champignon. {butterfly:live rest} Il a replié ses ailes, puis il les a agitées. Guili, guili. {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Ah… ah… [pause] {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ATCHOUM ! Des paillettes ont volé, puis sont retombées doucement… sur le nez de Hérisson. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:live curl} Hérisson s’est roulé en boule… puis il s’est déroulé, lentement. Son nez frémissait. Ah… {hedgehog:live sneeze} ah… {sfx:tiny-sneeze} atchi ! Son tout petit atchoum a soufflé les paillettes jusqu’à Renard. Le nez de Renard a frémi. Ah… ah… [pause] Tout le monde attendait. {all:face surprised} Mais au lieu d’éternuer… Renard {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} a pouffé de rire. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} Et ce fou rire a fait le tour de tout le pré.

it-IT.title: Lo starnuto che fa il giro
it-IT.text: [softly] {mushroom:enter} Fungo se ne stava tranquillo nel prato, e {hedgehog:enter} Riccio è arrivato zampettando {hedgehog:go to mushroom} per fare un pisolino accanto a lui. {hedgehog:face sleeping} Che pace. Poi è arrivata trotterellando {fox:enter} Volpe, e {butterfly:enter} Farfalla è scesa svolazzando {butterfly:go on fox} proprio sulla sua testa. Solletico, solletico. {fox:face surprised} {fox:live sneeze} Ah… ah… {sfx:big-sneeze} ETCIÙÙÙ! {fox:wobble x2} [surprised] FIUUU! Lo starnuto ha spinto Farfalla {butterfly:go on mushroom} fin sul cappello di Fungo. {butterfly:live rest} Lei ha chiuso le ali, poi le ha sbattute. Solletico, solletico. {mushroom:live sneeze hold} Ah… ah… [pause] {mushroom:live sneeze resume} {sfx:achoo} ETCIÙ! Una nuvoletta di brillantini è volata su, poi è scesa piano piano… sul naso di Riccio. {hedgehog:face surprised} {hedgehog:live curl} Riccio si è chiuso a palla… poi, pian pianino, ha fatto capolino. Il nasino gli prudeva. Ah… {hedgehog:live sneeze} ah… {sfx:tiny-sneeze} ciù! Il suo starnutino ha soffiato i brillantini fino a Volpe. A Volpe ha cominciato a prudere il naso. Ah… ah… [pause] Tutti aspettavano. {all:face surprised} Ma invece di starnutire… Volpe {fox:face happy} {fox:wobble} si è messa a ridacchiare. [laughs] {all:face happy} {all:wobble} E quella risatina ha fatto il giro di tutto il prato.

zh-TW.title: 繞了一圈的噴嚏
zh-TW.text: [softly]{mushroom:enter}蘑菇靜靜地站在草地上，{hedgehog:enter}刺蝟急急忙忙地跑過來，{hedgehog:go to mushroom}在她旁邊打瞌睡。{hedgehog:face sleeping}四周好安靜。這時，{fox:enter}狐狸小跑步過來，{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶輕輕飛下來，{butterfly:go on fox}剛好停在牠的頭上。癢癢的，癢癢的。{fox:face surprised}{fox:live sneeze}哈……哈……{sfx:big-sneeze}哈——啾！{fox:wobble x2}[surprised]呼！噴嚏把蝴蝶{butterfly:go on mushroom}吹到了蘑菇的菇傘上。{butterfly:live rest}蝴蝶合起翅膀，又拍了拍。癢癢的，癢癢的。{mushroom:live sneeze hold}哈……哈……[pause]{mushroom:live sneeze resume}{sfx:achoo}哈啾！一團亮晶晶的粉噗地飛起來，又慢慢飄下來……落在刺蝟的鼻子上。{hedgehog:face surprised}{hedgehog:live curl}刺蝟縮成一顆球……然後慢慢探出頭來。牠的鼻子動了動。哈……{hedgehog:live sneeze}哈……{sfx:tiny-sneeze}啾！牠小小的噴嚏，把亮晶晶的粉一路吹到狐狸那裡。狐狸的鼻子動了動。哈……哈……[pause]大家都在等。{all:face surprised}可是，狐狸沒有打噴嚏……{fox:face happy}{fox:wobble}牠咯咯笑了出來。[laughs]{all:face happy}{all:wobble}那個笑聲，繞著草地轉了一整圈。

zh-HK.title: 乞嗤傳一圈
zh-HK.text: [softly]{mushroom:enter}蘑菇靜靜地站在草地上。{hedgehog:enter}刺蝟急急腳走過來，{hedgehog:go to mushroom}在她身邊打瞌睡。{hedgehog:face sleeping}四周靜悄悄的。這時，{fox:enter}狐狸一路小跑過來，{butterfly:enter}蝴蝶輕輕飛下來，{butterfly:go on fox}剛好停在牠的頭頂。痕呀痕，痕呀痕。{fox:face surprised}{fox:live sneeze}哈……哈……{sfx:big-sneeze}哈——乞嗤！{fox:wobble x2}[surprised]呼！這個乞嗤把蝴蝶{butterfly:go on mushroom}吹到蘑菇帽上。{butterfly:live rest}蝴蝶合起翅膀，再拍一拍。痕呀痕，痕呀痕。{mushroom:live sneeze hold}哈……哈……[pause]{mushroom:live sneeze resume}{sfx:achoo}乞嗤！一團閃閃的金粉噴了出來，又慢慢飄下……落在刺蝟的鼻子上。{hedgehog:face surprised}{hedgehog:live curl}刺蝟縮成一個刺球……然後慢慢探出頭來。牠的鼻子抽了抽。哈……{hedgehog:live sneeze}哈……{sfx:tiny-sneeze}嗤！這個小小的乞嗤，把金粉一路吹到狐狸那裏。狐狸的鼻子抽了抽。哈……哈……[pause]大家都在等。{all:face surprised}可是狐狸沒有打乞嗤……{fox:face happy}{fox:wobble}牠咯咯地笑了出來。[laughs]{all:face happy}{all:wobble}這個笑聲，一個傳一個，傳遍了整片草地。
